facts.fact: Agence Ecofin reports Burkina Faso signed bilateral roaming agreements with Benin, Cote d'Ivoire and Senegal in Ouagadougou on 23 October, with entry into force expected in about three months.
Agence Ecofin reports Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger concluded a roaming agreement under the AES Confederation in November 2024, its operation announced for January 2025 with no recent confirmation.
